content.text: {"posting_id":"06c2599d-4dd5-4f97-843f-7194b546f042","claims":[{"kind":"role","claim":"The role is a software engineering role building web infrastructure.","quote":"Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences.","proposed_label":"supported"},{"kind":"seniority","claim":"The role is junior or entry level.","quote":"As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient.","proposed_label":"supported"},{"kind":"location","claim":"The job can be done in the US.","quote":"This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City.","proposed_label":"supported"},{"kind":"experience","claim":"The role requires at most 2 years of experience.","quote":"You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.","proposed_label":"insufficient"},{"kind":"sponsorship","claim":"The employer will sponsor a work visa.","quote":"","proposed_label":"insufficient"},{"kind":"skill","claim":"The work uses TypeScript.","quote":"Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.","proposed_label":"supported"}]}
